how_built: grown from Crossref returns for topic queries, then reviewed twice: a salience pass (a title obviously in another field) and a criterion pass organised by this paper's constructs (does the record name a mechanism, population or method the paper uses?). Every kept entry carries the query that produced it; refusals stay in the corpus with a reason and are counted, not deleted.

search_form.date_filter: none applied: neither endpoint was restricted
search_form.depth: relevance-ranked, top rows_per_query per query, no pagination

window.field: Crossref issued (the year each entry prints)
